text:
Ella: Dropped an updated prototype for the Prompt Sets / Evals list. Main changes: compact list mode, per-row expand for full prompt + regression diff, and a bulk-approve modal with required rationale. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/prompt-evals-v2 (comments enabled).

Omar: Quick backend questions before design is final: 1) bulk approve should require a reason (yes/no)? 2) do we need to store per-item rationale or one shared reason for the batch? This affects our audit schema.

Sasha: UX: default to compact rows to maximize density. Each row gets a chevron to expand inline. Expanded area shows prompt text, the small diff summary, and a "Show full diff" button. Also add an inline prompt preview (first 140 chars) in compact view.

Sasha: For long lists, fetch diffs lazily on expand to avoid heavy render costs. Also show a small green/red dot for quick pass/regress status.

Priya: Accessibility note: expanded sections must be reachable via keyboard and announced. Suggest using roving tabindex for rows and aria-live for diff load states. Example: `role="listitem" tabindex="-1"` on rows and update tabindex when focused.

James: A11y + color: the token pill color (#9aa0a6) is failing contrast at 13px. Recommend #4b5563 or bump font-weight 600. Also ensure focus outline uses 3:1 contrast with surrounding bg.

DesignBot: Prototype lint: detected focus order break when bulk-approve dialog opens in Safari. Logged: `focus-init-null -> modal-focus-fallback` with repro steps.

Ella: OK we require a reason. UX copy: modal title "Approve selected tests". Field label: "Reason (required)" and small helper text: "This reason will be stored in the audit trail and visible to reviewers." Button text options: "Approve (add reason)" vs "Approve selected — reason required". Leaning to short: "Approve selected" and enforce reason with placeholder.

Omar: Backend: we'll store one `batch_reason` for the request plus an array of per-item references (test_id). Endpoint idea: POST /audits/bulk_review { actor_id, test_ids[], batch_reason } -> returns { audit_id, item_count }. We'll also surface diff_hash in the audit for traceability.

Sasha: Selection UX: support tri-state parent checkboxes, show "12 selected" summary in the header, and enable Shift+click range select. Add a small inline counter near bulk actions for context.

James: Keyboard map proposal: Up/Down to move rows, Enter to expand, Space to toggle select, A to approve (opens modal), R to request review, ? to open shortcut help. Document these in the help tooltip (keyboard icon).

Priya: Screen reader flow when approve completes: announce "12 tests approved" via role=alert and move focus to the audit link in the success message. Also ensure the audit link is focusable and visible in the toast.

Sasha: For diffs UI: label them clearly like "Regression diff — model v3 → v4" and include small metadata: size, diff_hash, and a short snippet. Offer a compact inline summary and a "View full artifact" external link.

Omar: Good. Storing diff metadata (from_model, to_model, diff_hash, token_change_count) will let us reconstruct the diff in offline jobs. We'll add diff_hash to the audit response.

James: Also let's add aria-expanded and aria-controls on the chevron. Example mark-up snippet in the thread:```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="row-567-diff" aria-label="Expand prompt details for test 567">▸</button>
```

Ella: Design nit: compact row spacing should be 8px vertical, but when expanded the gap becomes 16px. Keep typography at 13px for compact, 14px for expanded. Add hover states for the diff preview to show a subtle shadow.

Priya: Also recommend ensuring the bulk modal traps focus and initial focus is on the textarea. Add aria-describedby linking to helper text. Test across VoiceOver and NVDA.

DesignBot: Accessibility scan passed token contrast after suggested color change, but still flags a missing aria-live on the diff loader.

Omar: I'll wire the endpoint and add the audit schema to the sprint ticket (RD-1456). Will include `audit_id`, `actor_id`, `batch_reason`, `test_ids[]`, `diff_hashes[]`, `created_at` in payload.

Sasha: I'll put up a PR with compact mode, row expand, and keyboard shortcuts today. Will include a demo recording for QA.

James: I'll run a dedicated accessibility pass on Sasha's branch focusing on focus traps, aria labels, and keyboard shortcuts. I'll post a short checklist in the PR.

Ella: Action items: Sasha - prototype + PR; Omar - backing endpoint & audit schema; James - a11y checklist + contrast token update; Priya - SR accessibility test matrix. We'll reconvene tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize copy and keyboard mapping. Thanks all! :tada:
